$comment: Identity schema for one record of a printed firm directory (knowledge_base/13 §1b): the thin, cross-volume-stable layer that record-level resolution consumes. Drafted 2026-11-10 from Compass 1877 and 1882 records. Copy into <project>/schemas/ and adjust; strict-mode friendly (every property required, nullable when absent, no extras). Copy values AS PRINTED; normalisation is the resolver's job.

serial_no.description: The running number printed before the name in this volume (e.g. '284.'); null if none.

name_hu.description: The firm's name in Hungarian exactly as printed, including a legal-form phrase that is part of the name (e.g. 'Török-Kanizsai kerületi takarékpénztár, mint részvénytársaság').

name_de.description: The firm's name in German exactly as printed (e.g. 'Török-Kanizsaer Bezirks-Sparcassa als Actiengesellschaft'); null if only one language is printed.

other_names.description: Any further name variant printed for the same firm (a third language, a former name, a trading name), each with its language code if known.

lang.description: ISO 639-1: hu, de, …; null if unclear.

legal_form.description: The legal form as printed or implied by the name: 'részvénytársaság' (joint-stock company), 'szövetkezet' (cooperative), 'egylet' (association), 'betéti társaság', 'közkereseti társaság', or another printed form; null if not stated.

seat.description: The seat (settlement) as printed, usually bold at the start of the first data line (e.g. 'Galánta', 'Budapest').

county.description: The county as printed after 'Megye—Comitat:' (e.g. 'Pozsony'); null if absent (e.g. Budapest entries).

address.description: Street address if printed (e.g. 'Deák Ferencz-utcza 3'); null otherwise.

founded.description: Year of foundation: the first year of 'Tartama—Dauer: 1873—1903' or a printed founding year; null if absent.

charter_until.description: The end year of the chartered duration ('Tartama—Dauer: 1873—1903' → 1903); null if absent or open-ended.

capital_nominal.description: Nominal share or founding capital as printed after 'Alaptőke'/'Actiencapital'/'Törzstőke', as a number in the printed currency (e.g. 100000).

capital_paid_in.description: Paid-in capital if the entry states it separately (e.g. '… 50 frt befizetéssel = 50,000 frt' → 50000); null if not stated or equal to nominal by omission.

currency.description: Currency unit of the capital figures as printed: 'frt' (forint), 'fl', 'K' (korona), …; null if no capital figure.

notes.description: Anything on the first lines that bears on identity and fits no field: a predecessor or successor mentioned, a merger, 'in liquidation', a second seat. Short, as printed. Null if nothing.
